algorithm: Query eligible fight.bJ(team0/1), compute integer mean INIT per team.
Higher mean team starts; ties fightID even team1, odd team0.
Within team sort INIT descending, effective level drk>0?drk:drm descending, deterministic hash ascending, actorID ascending.
Alternate teams while both have members; append all remaining actors from longer team.
verification: 3 unit tests and7 actual Java fex.rG reflection comparisons
limits: Eligibility is supplied by caller; dead/summon/ownership filtering is not inferred.
Summon insertion, turn delay, deaths, rounds and active-state mutations require separate SU/Tc/fem port.
